title: The Emotion Default
coreMove: Treat hot emotion and vulnerable body states as hazard conditions before choosing the next move.
sourcePressure: Emotion is the first fast default: anger, fear, outrage, urgency, hunger, fatigue, stress, distraction, and unfamiliar settings can possess the moment before facts or goals stabilize it. The Godfather contrast and Steve story show both strategic and irreversible costs.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning emotion into a villain or advising suppression instead of diagnosing when feeling has taken command.

sourceAnchors.name: Vito Corleone and Sonny Corleone
sourceAnchors.detail: the official excerpt contrasts Vito Corleone's patience and discipline with Sonny's quick temper and downfall in The Godfather
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Sonny's speed looks powerful until Vito's patience shows what discipline can protect.
